about_the_game:
We are currently in beta. You can get early access to this application by visiting our website.

Revolt — Own Your AI

Own your AI. Run powerful local models, connect to the cloud when you want, and build apps, games, and tools with total control over your data.
Revolt brings offline privacy, multi-mode workflows, and the Onyx development system into one sleek, powerful desktop application.

🛰 Local + Online AI

Run advanced models completely offline, keeping your work private and secure.
Need more horsepower? Seamlessly connect to online AI for enhanced capabilities — without giving up control.

🧰 The Toolbox System

Switch between powerful AI modes without changing apps:

  • Generate — Create text, code, or assets

  • Transform — Rewrite, reformat, or stylize

  • Analyze — Extract insights and process data

  • Automate — Chain AI tasks into workflows

🧱 Application Creation

Revolt includes the Onyx development model — a unified system for creating:

  • Games

  • Desktop applications

  • Interactive experiences

  • AI-assisted creative tools

All built faster, smarter, and integrated with the Toolbox.

💡 Key Features

  • Local + Online AI Support — Work offline or connect to the cloud on your terms

  • Multi-Mode Toolbox Workflows — Generate, transform, analyze, and automate

  • Onyx Development — Build games, apps, and tools with AI-assisted pipelines

  • Custom Personalities — Tailor AI behavior for any task

  • Private by Design — No required cloud sync, no data collection

  • Cross-Device License — Install on all your devices

🔒 Privacy First

Revolt is designed for complete offline operation:

  • Your conversations and files never leave your device

  • No tracking, analytics, or hidden data sharing

  • Optional cloud features are opt-in, not required

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not applicable
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not applicable
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading times

short_description: Own your AI, with Revolt. Supports both local and cloud-hosted models, enabling powerful workflows, and facilitating total data privacy. Currently available in beta, on our website.
